notes.title: Law School - Episode 1 Available now for Early Access Supporters
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are all doing well! 

Today is a special day for me, and I know this announcement can confuse some people or make them a bit lost. So, I want to be fully sincere and address right away why I am mentioning this here on Steam regarding a release I am doing on my Patreon page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/30dbded83bf4636cc76366f03614debf9f874a8c.png[/img]

[h3]Why Patreon? What about Steam?[/h3]

Some may not know, but [b]The Entrepreneur[/b] started as an early access project on Patreon, and once it evolved into a complete game, it was released on Steam. [i](This practice is common, if not standard, for 3D Adult Visual novel developers)[/i]

[b]It will be the same approach for Law School! [/b]Today marks the official release of Law School's first episode, which will be available for those who like to play/preview things very early through my Patreon page.

[b]Once Law School - Chapter 1  Development is 100% complete, I will release it on Steam immediately![/b]

I hope this makes things a bit cleaner right away. I sincerely appreciate the understanding and support both communities have given me so far; I can't express how fantastic everyone in the MisterMaya community is! :hearts: 

Now, I want to talk a bit more about Law School for those who are unfamiliar with this project:

[h2]Introducing “Law School”[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/b1ef708ff0e467050566056c1e5cb627ed160777.png[/img]
Embark on an exhilarating journey in “Law School” to become America's most renowned lawyer. At
18, fresh out of high school, you and your best friend Rose head to Stocklinburg University. This
prestigious institution is your gateway to mastering the legal landscape and realizing your dream.
Prepare for the challenges and vibrant experiences of a freshman in college.

[h2]Diverse and Engaging Cast[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/56c1a511b00e7e577db391635c508aba3f8a63f6.gif[/img]
“Law School” features six unique love interests, each crafted with meticulous attention to detail. My
characters boast distinct personalities and rich backstories, ensuring no two are alike. You'll find
yourself immersed in their development and narratives. In addition, a dynamic ensemble of secondary
characters - friends, adversaries, casual “acquaintances” (wink-wink), classmates, and staff - enrich
your daily college life, each contributing their own intriguing stories.

[h2]Immersive Gameplay[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/c6edf59f68aeefa407f9113abd7bfb605474e4bd.png[/img]
The gameplay in “Law School” goes beyond standard relationship management and story-affecting
decisions. Enjoy mini-games, optional free-roam events in each episode, and access to “Facegram,”
the game's integrated social media platform. Music selection is tailored to each scene, enhancing the
atmosphere.

[h2]To Summarize?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/f90df21aa486651e04143f941b8c2af881b42c3a.png[/img]
Law School is a MUCH BIGGER GAME than The Entrepreneur in which you'll experience the same
thrilling sensations, if not more. More sex, decisions, humor, and a new game system. All
together, they result in another dream, another cast of sexy girls, and another adventure all waiting for you.

Here is a comparison between the entire The Entrepreneur against Law School Episode 1

[u]The Entrepreneur[/u]

5200 images
160 animations
+230 songs
160 scenes

[u]Law School - Episode 1 
[/u]
3000 images 
71 animations
82 Songs
43 scenes + 1 Freeroam + Access to Facegram

notes.title: Law School: Episode 1 Development Update #4
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Law School Enthusiasts![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/d0d5b47a9dba1edea4169e637489e0b1bf5743ee.png[/img]
I'm thrilled to bring you the fourth development update for Law School – Episode 1. And today is an
important update, because I've got loads of important things to say, so let's start right away.

[h2]Progress Recap for Last Month[/h2]
First, an important milestone: I have completed all the story statics for Episode 1, albeit a month later
than planned. This delay was due to a series of unforeseen events, including illness, a back injury, and
additional work on my first game, "The Entrepreneur." While I won't delve into the specifics here, I'm
eager to announce that March will bring exciting news for "The Entrepreneur." Moreover, another
long-term project of mine related to "MisterMaya" is finally coming to fruition, and I look forward to
sharing it with you. These developments have contributed to the one-month delay, but thankfully, no
further delays have occurred since February.

[h2]Where Do We Stand Now?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/624019de11d72cd3de425cfbfe46ba2378abfe9e.png[/img]
To date, I have crafted 43 scenes, totaling almost 2,500 statics and 70 animations. Additionally, the
creation of a roaming event and two mini-games will increase the count of images and animations. The
dialogue has expanded to 8,500 lines, not counting the content from the roaming event.

[h2]Challenges Ahead[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/51872499a811c11236145c94ac3c24811dc9f100.png[/img]
I'm currently juggling the final tasks for "The Entrepreneur," which occupy 70% of my workload,
leaving 30% for "Law School." Completing these tasks within the next two weeks is crucial. The
pressure has cut into my sleep, but it's a challenge I'm determined to overcome. I'm also in the midst of
preparing "Law School" for a social media introduction, which requires the creation of numerous
promotional images.

[h2]Goals for the Upcoming Month[/h2]
My immediate objectives include developing the aforementioned mini-games and roaming event. I aim
to create 90 to 100 images for the characters' Facegram profiles, a task I estimate will take 2 to 3 days.
Following this, I'll review all images to adjust scenes as needed and address any issues such as
clipping or lighting. Typically, up to 5% of scenes require revision, a process that should take no more
than a day and a half, including rendering time. The final step is the post-work phase, which I hope to
complete in under two weeks. My ultimate goal is to finalize the first episode by the end of March and
then distribute it to testers.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/c95f28b43758e137eaf7f6c2e532062647f9600e.png[/img]
Completing the story statics phase was a significant achievement and brought me immense
satisfaction. As we approach the release, my anticipation grows, accompanied by the familiar nerves of
launching a new episode—a sentiment shared by developers everywhere. Despite the daunting
workload ahead, I'm optimistic about meeting my deadlines.

Back to the grindstone now—I can't wait to share this new game with you.

[b]Warm regards,
MisterMaya[/b]

notes.title: Law School: Episode 1 Development Update #3
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Law School Enthusiasts![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/dc38b4ed634bc52876615034bb9c26fc73ef7673.png[/img]
I'm thrilled to bring you the third development update for Law School – Episode 1. December was a
whirlwind month for me, filled with personal and professional milestones, including my birthday and
unexpected travels. Despite these, I've made significant headway on Law School's first episode,
especially in the last two weeks.

[h2]Progress Recap for Last Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/564e067d5b837b6793389953698836f9673a80b4.gif[/img]
Currently, I'm crafting the final scenes of Episode 1. Excluding the additional content like roaming
events and mini-games planned for later development, only eight scenes remain. I've also been
preparing exclusive wallpapers and promotional images, as we edge closer to release. Plus, I've
completed all but one of the LEWD scenes, which is a huge milestone given their complexity and
animation frame count.

[h2]Where Do We Stand Now?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/0ab1cca9430ffc03efe51e7b1066849b555cf78b.png[/img]
To date, I've created 35 scenes, amassing over 2100 story statics and more than 40 animations. While I
may not hit the 3000 story statics mark, the total will likely soar with the inclusion of images for minigames, roaming events, Facegram, and more. On the animation front, we might reach around 60
animations, slightly shy of the initial 80-target, unless time allows for additional creation.

[h2]Challenges Ahead[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/0b7ac36848043d1ce571b9f5d1350546b07d7445.png[/img]
My immediate focus is completing the story statics swiftly. The next development phase includes
creating and coding mini-game visuals, developing the free roam event, designing Facegram for
characters, optimizing the game's GUI, refining mechanics, and post-processing images and
animations. February will be a crucial month, culminating in the game's testing phase and an
anticipated early March release. Time management remains my primary challenge, along with
preparing a YouTube trailer and other promotional materials.

[h2]Goals for the Upcoming Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/5fb7473a2bef3b76065a6a090716747827d427a8.gif[/img]
The main goal is to finalize the story statics quickly, paving the way for mini-games and the free roam
event. Following this, a “beta test version” will be prepared for immediate testing, allowing me to
work on the final test version concurrently. This approach aims to optimize time and reduce delays.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/476a43da48b288bb39abb364ec03e60ce1a43d9f.png[/img]
It's almost hard to believe we're nearing the release of the game. It's like we're approaching the summit
of a long climb – it seems both incredibly near and yet still a stretch away. I'm genuinely excited, as I
have full confidence in the fun and quality that Law School will offer. I'm looking forward to seeing
you all embark on this journey I've created and discovering which characters resonate with you the
most.

Back to the grind now – every day brings us closer to the release of the first episode of Law School!
Warm regards,

MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School: Episode 1 Development Update #2
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Law School Enthusiasts![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/41c1ab352e98c33fd5caf4313fb1876df664d01a.png[/img]
I am thrilled to share with you the second update for "Law School: Journey to Becoming America's
Top Lawyer." Your warm reception of my demo has been incredibly heartening. Your positive
feedback and constructive criticism have been invaluable, and I assure you, every piece of advice and
concern is being considered to deliver an outstanding first episode.

[h2]Progress Recap for Last Month[/h2]
[previewyoutube=H_1rwePUS3k;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been a relatively slow month in the development of Law School, mainly due to the demo's release a
fortnight ago. Designing a unique and personalized game GUI from scratch was a hefty but rewarding
task. While the core coding of the game is established, allowing for easy tweaks and adjustments, there
may still be further enhancements as we approach the first episode's release.But I'm glad that Law
School will have a unique design, on which I work hard.

[h2]Improvement in the workflow[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/506760ddca99118074d67c6f60baa798af9e9871.png[/img]
I previously mentioned a bottleneck in my rendering process due to an overwhelming amount of
animations and statics. My second computer struggled with the load of over 300 statics and 2
animations, both of them totaling more than 200 frames; in the rendering queue.
However, upgrading to an RTX 4090 GPU has significantly expedited the process, reducing the queue
to just 40 statics.
This upgrade not only speeds up rendering but also enables me to add more animations, enhancing the
game's transition effects, a feature I'm particularly excited about.

[h2]Where do we stand now?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/2fac21c45b9cd404e25bfdd687da7ca156a97ead.png[/img]
As of now, Law School boasts approximately 1900 statics and 31 animations, with over half of the
content complete. I'm confident that we are on track for a March 2024 release, anticipating around
3000 statics and 60 animations to create a well-rounded first episode.

[h2]Goals for the upcoming month[/h2]
[previewyoutube=UKM0HZFBUcE;full][/previewyoutube]
The primary focus for the next month is to complete the remaining 1000 statics and additional
animations by January's end. This will allow February to be dedicated to post-production tasks such as
editing, coding, music composition, and testing, gearing up for the March release.
Ensuring thorough testing by our dedicated testers is crucial to avoid the pitfalls experienced with
previous releases of "The Entrepreneur."
Our goal is to launch a flawless first episode for Law School.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/5e4389a2630cb6e39b6580d935b97537f3a1d72b.png[/img]
This month has been a rewarding journey, filled with a blend of excitement and anxiety. Seeing the
game take shape and receiving such positive community feedback is both affirming and motivating. I
eagerly await the moment when you can experience the game in its full glory. I hope it brings you as
much joy as it has brought me in its creation.

Now, back to the grind – another day, another scene!

Warm regards,

MisterMaya

notes.title: Law School: Journey to Becoming America's Top Lawyer
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction to “Law School”[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/b1ef708ff0e467050566056c1e5cb627ed160777.png[/img]
Embark on an exhilarating journey in “Law School” to become America's most renowned lawyer. At
18, fresh out of high school, you and your best friend Rose head to Stocklingburg University. This
prestigious institution is your gateway to mastering the legal landscape and realizing your dream.
Prepare for the challenges and vibrant experiences of a freshman in college.

[h3]Diverse and Engaging Cast[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/56c1a511b00e7e577db391635c508aba3f8a63f6.gif[/img]
“Law School” features six unique love interests, each crafted with meticulous attention to detail. My
characters boast distinct personalities and rich backstories, ensuring no two are alike. You'll find
yourself immersed in their development and narratives. In addition, a dynamic ensemble of secondary
characters - friends, adversaries, casual “acquaintances” (wink-wink), classmates, and staff - enrich
your daily college life, each contributing their own intriguing stories.

[h3]Immersive Gameplay[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/c6edf59f68aeefa407f9113abd7bfb605474e4bd.png[/img]
The gameplay in “Law School” goes beyond standard relationship management and story-affecting
decisions. Enjoy mini-games, optional free-roam events in each episode, and access to “Facegram”,
the game's integrated social media platform. Music selection is tailored to each scene, enhancing the
atmosphere. Players can also change tracks for varied gameplay experiences.

[h3]To Summarize?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/367d007f9730aa238dbfff3ad663f1cd5a87d127.png[/img]
Law School will be a much bigger project that The Entrepreneur in which you'll experience the same
thrilling sensations, if not more. More sex, more decisions, more humour, new game system. All
together they result in another dream, another cast of sexy girls, another adventure all awaiting for you.

[h3]Progress So Far[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/b87b3f35bc6e38f0dc1ebf6a9084f1b7ce78b894.gif[/img]
In the past three months, over 1500 story statics, 22 animations, and more than 6000 lines of dialogue
have been created. My goal is to double these numbers for the first episode. As a dedicated developer
working full time on my game around 70-80 hours a week, I'm thrilled with my progress and
motivated to keep pushing boundaries.

[h3]Exciting Developments[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/0634813987f0ab0d35ff2450861aa1bfa63ebe21.png[/img]
I've brought on board an animator to elevate the quality of the game's more mature animations. This
collaboration not only adds realism but also frees up my time to focus on other development aspects. A
demo is slated for early December release, offering a glimpse into the game's world, art, and
characters.

Voice acting negotiations during LEWD scenes are also underway to add another layer to the game's
immersive experience.

[h3]Challenges Ahead[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/980b679e1dcc0d1d50fe54a43242bd27a35d9752.png[/img]
The sheer volume of animations and statics presents a bottleneck in my rendering capabilities. Despite
running my station for about 16 hours a day, the output is limited. To address this, I'm upgrading to a
GeForce RTX 4090, which should significantly speed up rendering times. My aim is to complete the
game by mid-February for an early March release.

[h3]Final Thoughts[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453988/2fbae1d368b7c809dec12010527c96cb4bec9dc3.png[/img]
As a developer, the initial stages of a project are always a mix of stress and excitement. These past
months have been incredibly fulfilling, and I'm eager to share the demo and the first episode. For more
regular updates, including sneak peeks of new characters, follow my Patreon page. Now, back to work
– there's a game waiting to be created!

Best regards,

MisterMaya
